title: Universal cochain presentation of independent-universe ringed pullback
statement: Let C and D be sites small relative to a coefficient universe r, with topologies J_C and J_D, and let R on C and S,R_I on D be sheaves of commutative rings in that universe. Use their actual categories A and B of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and chosen unbounded derived categories in a common universe w [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let uInv be a finite-limit-preserving left adjoint between sheaves of sets, I an algebraic inverse image of R to R_I over uInv [def-weil-pbc-algebraic-inverse-image], and c:R_I → S. Let T:A → B be additive and be presented, on objects and morphisms, by I.modules followed by scalar extension along c. There exist F:D(A) → D(B) and a cochain counit ε: F Q_A → Q_B T^c such that F is the right Kan extension of Q_B T^c along Q_A with counit ε. For every flat-term K-flat complex P [def-pc-kflat-complex, def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], ε_P is invertible. No equality between site and coefficient universes is assumed.

proof.text: Apply the independent-universe ringed derived pullback theorem to the specified inverse-image and scalar-extension presentation of T. Keep the resulting derived functor F, its universal homotopy counit, and its invertibility on flat-term K-flat complexes. Its left-derived property supplies the homotopy right Kan property.

proof.text: Apply universal cochain counit transport to T, F and the homotopy counit. Take the transported cochain counit. The transport theorem gives its right Kan universality; its componentwise IsIso equivalence carries the resolving-class computation to every flat-term K-flat cochain complex. The underlying module-sheaf categories are Mathlib categories, so no semilinear implementation abbreviation or instance is required in the public interface.

theorem ringedPullbackCochainPresentation
    (uInv : Sheaf JC (Type r) ⥤ Sheaf JD (Type r))
    (uPush : Sheaf JD (Type r) ⥤ Sheaf JC (Type r))
    (adj : uInv ⊣ uPush) [PreservesFiniteLimits uInv]
    (I : AlgebraicInverseImage uInv R RI) (c : RI ⟶ S)
    (uStar : SheafOfModules.{r} ((sheafCompose JC (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).obj R) ⥤
      SheafOfModules.{r} ((sheafCompose JD (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).obj S))
    (hobj : ∀ M : SheafOfModules.{r}
          ((sheafCompose JC (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).obj R),
      uStar.obj M = changeOfRings c (I.modules.obj M))
    (hmap : ∀ {M N : SheafOfModules.{r}
          ((sheafCompose JC (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).obj R)}
      (a : M ⟶ N), uStar.map a =
        eqToHom (hobj M) ≫ changeOfRingsHom c (I.modules.obj M) (I.modules.map a) ≫
          eqToHom (hobj N).symm)
    [uStar.Additive]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{r}
          ((sheafCompose JC (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).obj R))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{r}
          ((sheafCompose JD (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).obj S))] :
    ∃ (F : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{r}
          ((sheafCompose JC (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).obj R)) ⥤
        DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{r}
          ((sheafCompose JD (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).obj S)))
      (ε : DerivedCategory.Q (C := SheafOfModules.{r}
          ((sheafCompose JC (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).obj R)) ⋙ F ⟶
        uStar.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙
          DerivedCategory.Q (C := SheafOfModules.{r}
          ((sheafCompose JD (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).obj S))),
      F.IsRightKanExtension ε ∧
        ∀ P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{r}
          ((sheafCompose JC (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).obj R)) ℤ,
          P.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients →
          (∀ n : ℤ, IsFlatOnSite (J := JC) (R := R) (P.X n)) →
          IsIso (ε.app P)
